leftEvidence.title: The woman is built and brought to the man

points.label: Formation order
points.left: The man names animals but finds no matching helper; God builds the woman, brings her to him, and the source moves into kinship, one flesh, and unashamed nakedness.
points.right: The instruction says Adam was formed first and was not deceived, while the woman was deceived and fell into disobedience.

points.label: Source setting
points.left: Created, formed, and placed · core · Genesis 2:18–25
points.right: Adam, Christ, and embodied life · later memory · 1 Timothy 2:11–15

payload.posture: The man is present before the woman is built and brought to him is held beside Adam is said to be formed first and not deceived, while the woman is deceived.

rightEvidence.title: The letter distinguishes formation and deception

payload.tension: The letter draws claims about formation and deception from a story that narrates both people eating.
payload.title: Genesis and 1 Timothy on order and action
